admission.justification: The shipped-brief, instruction-census and retired-wording cases reject a named candidate interpreter returning to product instructions.

applicability: Product lifecycle role, operation and template instructions for running a task candidate, including every shipped worker-brief copy.
conditions: Repository tool notes own the build command and interpreter choice.
Where the notes name no command the agent discloses that gap; run records name the interpreter actually used.
exclusions: Historical quoted interpreter wording and ignore patterns.
statement: No product role text names an interpreter for a candidate; the worker brief points at the tool notes and requires run records to name the interpreter used.
